agentProfiles.name: Planning
agentProfiles.notes: Use for architecture, root-cause investigation, comparing approaches, and writing plans. Do not use for bulk implementation.

agentProfiles.name: Implementation
agentProfiles.notes: Use for implementing a clear, scoped change in its own worktree and running the focused tests.

agentProfiles.name: Review
agentProfiles.notes: Use for independent review of a diff: correctness, missing tests, unnecessary complexity. Read-only; do not edit files.
